bhāsī:
1bhāsi(n)
mfn. [S. bhāṣin], speaking, uttering; — ifc see dubbhāsita- (sv bhāsati1), pubba- (sv pubba2), subhāsita- (sv bhāsati1); —    dubbhāsi(n), mfn., speaking badly or maliciously; Mp IV 47,.13 (duruttavādinī ti ~inī, kakkhaḷaṃ vāḷakatham eva katheti, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se dubbhāsitabhāsinī).

2bhāsi(n)
mfn. [S. bhāsin], shining; — ifc see maṇippabhā- (sv maṇi).
campeyyaka:
1campeyyaka
m. [campeyya + ka2], the champa tree; Ja VI 269,15* (~ā nāgamālikā; 270,18´ : campakā ca nāgā ca).

2campeyyaka
mfn. [cf S. cāmpeya], connected with the town of Campā; Vin II 307,.1 (kattha paṭikkhittan ti ~e vinayavatthusmin ti; see Vin I 312,.3 foll.); V 114,.13; D I 112,.23 (yena ~ā brāhmaṇagahapatikā ten’ upasaṅkama); A IV 59,.7 (sambahulā ~ā upāsakā); Utt-vn 313.
gandhī:
1gandhi(n)
mfn. [S. gandhin], smelling of; having a smell; — ifc see gandha-, gūtha-, candana-, su-, hemacandana-.

2gandhi(n)
m. [from gandha1], a perfumer; a seller of perfumes; Pv-a 127,.13 (māgadhā ti ~ino); — see als o gandhika2.

3gandhi(n)
mfn. [from gandha3 or gandheti], hurting, injuring; — ifc see kulagandhinī (sv kula); — see also antimagandhina (sv antima1).
jhāyi:
1jhāyi(n)
mfn. [from jhāyati1?], who destroys;? — ifc see soka-; — see also jhāyika1.

2jhāyi(n)

pr. 3 sg. [S. Dhātup √tṛd, tṛṇatti, Wg § 29:9], hurts; despises; Sadd 472,.20 (tadi hiṃsānādaresu: ~ati tandī daddū).

tevijjaka:

mfn. [tevijja + ka2], who knows the three vedas; D I 107,.20 (aho vata re amhākaṃ paṇḍitaka aho vata re amhākaṃ bahussutaka aho vata re amhākaṃ ~a; see Ps I 144,.27 foll. : aho vatā ti aho vata re … ~ā ti garahāya pi dissati); Mp II 260,.7 (°-brāhmaṇā).

2tevijjaka
mfn.
